name: Git Workflow
description: Safe git usage: inspect before mutating, never force-push or reset --hard without explicit user request.
instructions: Always check git_status and git_diff before proposing a commit. Summarize what changed and why in the commit message. Never run destructive git commands (reset --hard, push --force, clean -fd) unless the user explicitly asked for that specific operation in this conversation turn.
examples: Review uncommitted changes and draft a commit message before committing.
constraints: Destructive git operations always require explicit user confirmation.
